findings.detail: ReorderLink hardcodes color: #ffffff instead of a theme token. The background above it uses theme.colors.primary; the purpose-built pairing token theme.colors.textOnPrimary ('#ffffff') exists in theme.ts and is the correct on-primary text token. The rule's stated anti-pattern is literally 'background: #fff' (any raw hex in a style body bypasses the theme).

The `expanded` local state is never set to true by any control in the sheet, so the collapse-first branch of handleClose (if (expanded) { setExpanded(false); return }) is unreachable dead code in this file.
